title: Read bounded protocol frames from a connection
spec: Read exactly one length-prefixed frame from a reader. Expose the original wire frame and its payload without a second copy. Limit allocation and consumption to the smaller of the phase limit and MAX_FRAME. An empty stream returns None, a partial frame is UnexpectedEof, and an excessive length is InvalidData without reading the body. Coalesced later frames remain readable. Debug output never includes frame contents. No new dependencies.
